title: Centroid Spectral Coupling: Implicit Alignment and Representation Diversity in Self-Supervised Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22158v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) aims to align augmented views while preserving representation diversity and preventing collapse. Existing non-contrastive methods often address these goals using multiple weighted loss terms. We introduce Centroid Spectral Coupling (CSC), a single-term SSL objective that implicitly couples view alignment, representation diversity, and collapse resistance. CSC constructs centroids from independently normalized augmented-view pairs and applies a ridge-based spectral objective to their uncentered second-moment matrix. Preserving centroid magnitudes encodes view agreement while encouraging balanced representation energy across spectral directions. We establish an exact decomposition into nonnegative alignment and spectral-imbalance components, characterize the geometry of global optima, and derive finite-loss guarantees for alignment and diversity. translated_abstract: 自监督学习（SSL）旨在对齐增强视图，同时保持表示多样性并防止坍缩。现有的非对比方法通常使用多个加权损失项来实现这些目标。我们提出了质心谱耦合（CSC），这是一个单项的SSL目标函数，它隐式地将视图对齐、表示多样性和抗坍缩能力耦合在一起。CSC从独立归一化的增强视图对构建质心，并对其未中心化的二阶矩矩阵应用基于岭正则化的谱目标。保持质心的幅值编码了视图之间的一致性，同时促使表示能量在各个谱方向上均衡分布。我们建立了一个精确的分解，将其分解为非负的对齐分量与谱不平衡分量，刻画了全局最优解的几何性质，并推导出对齐与多样性的有限损失保证。我们还证明了完全恒定输出的坍缩是一个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出质心谱耦合（CSC）——一种单项自监督学习目标函数，通过基于质心二阶矩矩阵的谱优化，隐式地同时实现视图对齐、表示多样性和抗坍缩，并给出精确分解与理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Centroid Spectral Coupling (CSC), a single-term self-supervised learning objective that implicitly couples view alignment, representation diversity, and collapse resistance via a ridge-based spectral objective on centroid second-moment matrices, with exact decomposition and theoretical guarantees.
